title: RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer
abstract: Simulation enables large-scale, low-cost robot data generation, but policies trained in simulation often fail to transfer to the real world due to the sim-to-real visual discrepancies. Existing approaches often rely on intermediate representations, which can discard rich semantic information or require additional perception modules at deployment. We address this visual sim-to-real gap with RoboRender, a framework that converts simulated trajectories into photorealistic RGB videos for policy learning. RoboRender trains a robot-oriented video generation model conditioned on simulated depth videos, language instructions, and robot RGB mask videos, preserving simulator geometry, robot motion, and action labels while synthesizing realistic textures, backgrounds, and distractors. The generated RGB videos are paired with simulator-provided states and actions to train policies for zero-shot real-world deployment. On robot video test sets, our video model outperforms depth-conditioned video generation baselines in generation quality. In real-world experiments across pick-and-place, articulated-object manipulation, and mobile manipulation tasks, policies trained on RoboRender-generated data achieve a 71% average success rate, outperforming raw simulation renderings and conventional visual domain randomization by approximately 7.1x and 3.6x, respectively. We further show that policy performance improves with more generated videos per simulation trajectory, increasing opening-task success by 65 percentage points. These results demonstrate that generative video rendering mitigates the visual sim-to-real gap for zero-shot policy transfer. Project website: this https URL.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a graduate course on Robot Learning and Sim-to-Real Transfer, today’s lecture is on RoboRender. Recent work such as Sim-and-Real Co-Training and ReBot explores ways to make robot learning benefit from broader mixtures or new forms of visual data. RoboRender takes a different route: it starts with simulated robot experience and changes its appearance. That matters because a policy can learn the right action in simulation yet struggle to recognize a real scene. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在一门关于机器人学习与仿真到现实迁移的研究生课程中，今天的讲座讲的是RoboRender。最近像Sim-and-Real Co-Training和ReBot这样的工作，探索了如何让机器人学习从更广泛的混合数据或新形式的视觉数据中获益。RoboRender走的是另一条路：它从仿真机器人经验出发，改变它的外观。这很重要，因为一个策略可以在仿真中学会正确的动作，却难以识别真实场景。是的，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, is RoboRender changing what the robot does, or only what it sees?
segments.zh: 教授您好，RoboRender改变的是机器人的动作，还是只改变它看到的东西？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Only what it sees. The simulator still supplies the robot’s motion, scene geometry, states, and action labels. A video generator turns that simulated experience into realistic-looking color video, which is then paired with the original actions for policy training. Think of filming the same staged performance with different scenery: the appearance changes, but the movements remain. The paper tests whether this visual change helps policies transfer to real robots.
segments.zh: 只是它看到的东西变了。模拟器仍然提供机器人的运动、场景几何、状态和动作标签。视频生成器把这些模拟经验变成看起来逼真的彩色视频，然后再和原始动作配对，用于策略训练。可以想象成用不同的布景拍摄同一场舞台表演：外观变了，但动作没变。这篇论文测试的就是这种视觉上的变化能不能帮助策略迁移到真实机器人上。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The method has three main ingredients. First, simulation produces synchronized depth videos from several camera views, along with robot masks that identify the robot in the image. Second, a video generator uses those signals and language prompts to create realistic R-G-B frames. The prompts can vary things like materials, lighting, and backgrounds. Finally, each generated video is matched with the simulator’s states and actions, so the policy learns from realistic-looking images without replacing the underlying task information.
segments.zh: 这个方法有三个主要组成部分。第一，仿真会从多个相机视角生成同步的深度视频，同时生成机器人掩码，用来在图像中标识机器人的位置。第二，视频生成器利用这些信号和语言提示来生成逼真的RGB画面。提示可以改变材质、光照和背景等元素。最后，每个生成的视频都会与仿真器的状态和动作配对，这样策略就能从看起来逼真的图像中学习，同时不替换底层的任务信息。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: if the video is generated, how does it stay faithful to the simulated action?
segments.zh: 问个快问题：视频既然是生成的，那它怎么保证跟模拟的动作一致呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Depth provides a geometric anchor: it helps preserve the positions and motion of objects. Robot masks preserve visual cues about the robot’s shape and movement, while prompts guide appearance changes. The method also generates multiple camera views jointly rather than rendering each view independently. That shared process is intended to keep common scene elements aligned across cameras. It is a useful distinction: realistic appearance is the goal, but the simulator remains the source of the action sequence.
segments.zh: 深度提供了几何锚点，有助于保持物体的位置和运动。机器人掩码保留了关于机器人形状和运动的视觉线索，而提示词则引导外观变化。该方法还联合生成多个相机视角，而不是独立渲染每个视角。这种共享过程旨在让不同相机之间的共同场景元素保持一致。这是一个有用的区分：目标是逼真的外观，但动作序列的来源仍然是模拟器。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The generator works in chunks for longer trajectories. Its window covers up to 81 frames; for a longer video, it creates one chunk and uses that chunk’s last frame as context for the next. The system can also introduce distractor objects by leaving selected regions unconstrained by depth and prompting the generator to add objects there. This gives the training images variation while keeping task-relevant geometry tied to simulation.
segments.zh: 生成器在处理较长轨迹时是分块工作的。它的窗口最多覆盖81帧；对于更长的视频，它会先生成一个块，然后用这个块的最后帧作为下一个块的上下文。系统还可以通过让选定区域不受深度约束、并提示生成器在那里添加物体，来引入干扰物体。这样既能让训练图像有变化，又能让与任务相关的几何信息仍然与仿真绑定。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify what the paper means by zero-shot transfer here?
segments.zh: 你能澄清一下论文里说的零样本迁移在这里具体指什么吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It means the task policy is deployed on the real robot without fine-tuning that policy on real-world data. It does not mean the video generator learned without real data: the renderer was trained using real robot videos. That distinction matters when interpreting the result. RoboRender aims to avoid real-world policy adaptation, but it relies on a renderer that has already learned from real visual examples.
segments.zh: 意思是任务策略直接部署到真实机器人上，没有用真实世界的数据对这个策略做微调。但这不意味着视频生成器没学过真实数据：渲染器是用真实机器人的视频训练出来的。理解结果的时候，这个区别很关键。RoboRender的目标是避免在真实世界里做策略适配，但它依赖的渲染器已经先从真实视觉样本里学过了。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The real-robot evaluation covers eight tasks: five pick-and-place tasks, two opening tasks involving a fridge and a drawer, and one mobile-manipulation task. Each task has ten evaluation rollouts, and the reported average gives equal weight to each task’s success rate. Across these tests, RoboRender averages 71% success, compared with 20% for simulation with visual domain randomization and 10% for raw simulation.
segments.zh: 真机评测覆盖了八个任务：五个抓取放置任务、两个打开任务（分别开冰箱和抽屉），还有一个移动操作任务。每个任务做十次评测轨迹，报告的平均值对每个任务的成功率等权处理。在这些测试中，RoboRender平均成功率为71%，而带视觉域随机化的仿真只有20%，原始仿真只有10%。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: The opening results sound different from the average; what happens on those tasks?
segments.zh: 开门任务的结果听起来和平均值不太一样，这些任务上到底发生了什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: For fridge opening, RoboRender reaches 70% success, and for drawer opening it reaches 90%. Both comparison methods score 0% on both tasks. The authors suggest that fine visual details, such as a handle whose texture blends with the surrounding object, may make these tasks difficult. That explanation is plausible, but the evaluation does not isolate it as the sole cause. The measured result is that RoboRender performs better in these tested settings.
segments.zh: 对于开冰箱这个任务，RoboRender达到了70%的成功率，开抽屉则达到了90%。而两个对比方法在这两个任务上都是0%。作者认为，像把手纹理和周围物体混在一起这种精细的视觉细节，可能让这些任务变得困难。这个解释说得通，但评估并没有把它单独拎出来证明是唯一原因。能测到的结果就是，在这些测试场景下RoboRender表现更好。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors also test embodiments that were not used to train the renderer, and report higher success than the baselines on those tested robots. This is evidence of transfer across the particular embodiments and setups in the study, not proof of broad generalization. The evaluation took place in a natural office environment with differences from simulation in object size, geometry, camera viewpoint, and background. Simulated dynamics and contact can still limit performance.
segments.zh: 作者还测试了未用于训练渲染器的具体机器人形态，并报告在这些测试机器人上成功率高于基线。这证明了在研究涉及的特定形态和设置之间具有迁移性，但并不证明具有广泛的泛化能力。评估是在一个真实的办公环境中进行的，该环境在物体尺寸、几何形状、相机视角和背景方面都与仿真存在差异。仿真动力学和接触仍然可能限制性能。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How do we know the improvement comes from joint multi-view generation, rather than simply giving a model several views?
segments.zh: 我们怎么知道性能提升来自联合多视角生成，而不只是给模型输入多个视角呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The paper gives depth-conditioned comparison systems the same three-view input at inference. Stacking views alone does not close the gap: RoboRender has lower reported F-I-D and F-V-D scores in that comparison, where lower is better. Qualitative examples also show shared elements, such as a table, appearing inconsistent between views for some stacked baselines. This supports a narrow conclusion: inference-time stacking is insufficient by itself. It does not prove that multi-view training alone explains the difference.
segments.zh: 论文在推理时给深度条件对比系统同样的三视图输入。光靠堆叠视图并不能弥合差距：在那项对比中，RoboRender报告的F-I-D和F-V-D分数更低，而分数越低越好。定性示例也显示，对一些堆叠基线来说，桌子等共享元素在不同视图之间看起来并不一致。这支持一个有限的结论：仅靠推理时堆叠还不够。它并不能证明差异完全来自多视图训练。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A separate experiment asks whether more visual variety can help when the number of unique simulation trajectories stays fixed. Using half the simulation trajectories, the researchers generate multiple visual versions by resampling prompts and depth patches. Pick-and-place success rises from 48% with one version to 58% with two, then levels off at three. Opening success rises from 0% to 45% and then 65% as the number of versions increases. This is not evidence of lower total computation.
segments.zh: 另一个独立实验想弄清楚：在唯一仿真轨迹数量固定的情况下，增加视觉多样性是否有帮助。研究者用一半的仿真轨迹，通过重新采样提示词和深度图块，生成多个视觉版本。抓取放置的成功率从一个版本的48%升到两个版本的58%，到三个版本时趋于平稳。开合任务的成功率则随着版本数增加，从0%升到45%，再到65%。这并不能说明总计算量更低。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The broader connection is to work such as ReBot, which also uses synthesized robot video to support learning, and to sim-and-real co-training, which combines data sources. RoboRender emphasizes a particular balance: use simulated structure and action labels, but provide the policy with realistic visual cues. Its results suggest that generated appearance can be useful when the task depends on recognizing objects and details. Further studies would need to test more robots, environments, and longer tasks.
segments.zh: 更广泛的联系在于ReBot这类工作，它也使用合成机器人视频来支持学习，以及虚实协同训练，它把不同数据源结合起来。RoboRender强调一种特定的平衡：利用模拟的结构和动作标签，但为策略提供逼真的视觉线索。它的结果表明，当任务依赖于识别物体和细节时，生成的外观可以是有用的。进一步的研究需要测试更多机器人、环境和更长的任务。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the central claim is about preserving useful supervision while changing the visual domain?
segments.zh: 所以核心主张就是在改变视觉域的同时保留有用的监督信号？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. RoboRender does not claim to fix inaccurate physics or contact simulation; it targets the visual gap. Its real-robot results show that, in the evaluated tasks, a policy can benefit from realistic R-G-B views while retaining simulator-provided actions and structure. The memorable takeaway is simple: change how the simulated experience looks, without changing what the simulator says happened. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 没错。RoboRender并不声称能解决物理或接触模拟不准确的问题，它针对的是视觉层面的差距。它的真机结果表明，在所评估的任务中，策略能够从逼真的RGB视图中获益，同时保留模拟器提供的动作和结构。最值得记住的一点很简单：改变模拟体验看起来的样子，而不改变模拟器所记录发生的事情。感谢收听。如果还有任何问题，可以询问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
